subject: Future Tech
title: Who Owns Your Brain Data?
description: A short lesson to help you apply Who Owns Your Brain Data?.

hook.text: When a BCI records your neural signals, who owns that data? You, the company, or the doctor who implanted it?

buildup.text: Most BCI companies' terms of service claim broad rights to collected neural data for research and improvement.

discovery.text: Unlike a photo or a text message, brain data can reveal thoughts you never intended to share. The stakes are higher.

twist.text: If a company shuts down, what happens to your brain data? There's no precedent for what deletion even means here.

climax.text: Ethicists argue brain data should be treated like genetic data: heavily regulated, never sold, always anonymized.

punchline.text: Your brain data is the last private frontier.

quiz.question: Why is brain data considered more sensitive than typical personal data?
